operations.name: hn_search
operations.description: Full-text search over Hacker News stories and comments, ranked by relevance. A demand signal with dates and vote counts attached, which a web search result summary is not: use it to check whether people are actually asking for a thing, what they already use, and what they complain about. No API key and no meaningful rate limit. Read-only.

tags.describe: Filter by type: story, comment, ask_hn, show_hn, or a combination written as (story,comment)

numericFilters.describe: Numeric conditions, comma-separated: points>50, created_at_i>1750000000 (unix seconds), num_comments>10

operations.name: hn_search_recent
operations.description: The same Hacker News search ordered newest-first instead of by relevance. Use it when the question is whether something is still happening rather than what the canonical thread was -- a two-year-old top-ranked thread and a discussion from last week are very different evidence for a market. Read-only.

tags.describe: Filter by type, as in hn_search
